classification.difficultyReason: Read marked positions between hundredth ticks and choose the nearest hundredth, including a location just below halfway.

content.prompt: Use the number line to round each number to 2 decimal places.

spec.description: Number line from 5.7 to 5.8 with every hundredth labelled. Three downward red arrows have lowercase labels a, b and c.
spec.mathematics: a is between 5.71 and 5.72, nearer 5.71; b is between 5.75 and 5.76, nearer 5.76; c is between 5.79 and 5.8, just left of the midpoint and nearer 5.79. Arrow coordinates reconstruct source-relative positions and do not assert exact unprinted input values.
spec.answerVisibility: Input arrows and their labels are permanent givens. Rounded answers are absent.

answer.worked: The arrow is between $5.71$ and $5.72$, closer to $5.71$. Rounded to 2 decimal places, the number is $5.71$.
The arrow is between $5.75$ and $5.76$, closer to $5.76$. Rounded to 2 decimal places, the number is $5.76$.
The arrow is just left of halfway between $5.79$ and $5.80$, so it is closer to $5.79$. Rounded to 2 decimal places, the number is $5.79$.
